name: Kemang
tagline: Leafy expat enclave with cafes and bars
description: A leafy South Jakarta neighborhood long popular with expats, packed with cafes, restaurants, bars, galleries and coworking spaces. Its international vibe, walkable pockets and nightlife make it a favorite base for foreigners and nomads.
bestFor: Digital nomads wanting cafes, coworking, nightlife and an international community

name: Menteng
description: A prestigious colonial-era central district known for wide tree-lined streets, grand houses, parks and embassies. Central, green and relatively calm, it offers museums, markets and easy access to the city's business core.
bestFor: Travellers wanting a central, quiet and green base near the city core

name: Senopati and SCBD
description: The sleek South Jakarta zone spanning Senopati and the Sudirman Central Business District, dense with skyscrapers, offices, rooftop bars and top restaurants. It is the modern, upscale heart of the city's business and dining scene.
bestFor: Professionals and nomads wanting modern offices, dining and central business energy

name: Kota Tua
description: The historic old town of Batavia in North Jakarta, with Dutch colonial buildings, cobbled Fatahillah Square, museums and cafes. Atmospheric and heritage-rich, it is more a cultural draw than a comfortable long-stay nomad base.
bestFor: Culture-focused travellers wanting colonial heritage, museums and photo-worthy old streets
